title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols
  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testingAI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)

  • You’ve led a team of 4‑8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process

Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How We Work

  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

World-Class Benefits

  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada)
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

title: Accessibility Manager
description:
Department: Social Responsibility & Education

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability supports the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity. This role plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including:
  • Auditing of official FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring improvements to fulfil those requirements are implemented.
  • Working with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Developing and delivering accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.
  • Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that:
  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.
  • As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team:
  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile – Minimum Requirements

  • A deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leverage the unique value of mega‑sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people.
  • At least 5 years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes.
  • Experience of working in a comparable role in an international, fast‑paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritise effectively, and work independently.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), planning software and online collaboration tools.

Additional Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations.
  • In‑depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega‑sporting events.
  • Experience developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications experience.
  • Experience working in sports and/or events.
  • International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the tournament and to the assigned host city for the tournament operational period.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
Posted date: 1/12/2026

Type: Full-time

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo‑banks, fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast‑growing business. With full‑year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass‑consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose‑built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail‑oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM.
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a.
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it.
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape.

What we offer

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child.
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

No agencies. We do not accept CVs from 3rd parties.

Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Atuar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas ou pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz (Tableau, Power BI e/ou Looker).
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager.
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/Composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Competências Técnicas

  • Capacidade de projetar pipelines de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e DevOps para integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio.
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência para atender demandas críticas.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança colaborativa.
  • Compromisso com a aprendizagem contínua e atualização tecnológica.

  • Criar fluxos de processos para as atividades-chave.
  • Fornecer soluções de engenharia e visualizações das soluções propostas como parte da resposta técnica em RFQ.

Se você tem os requisitos abaixo, essa é sua chance de entrar para esse time de alto desempenho e fazer parte desse grande momento na nossa organização!

Presentes em Belo Horizonte, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, há 20 anos, somos a escola responsável por transformar vidas por meio da educação. Job Description

Buscamos um profissional organizado, analítico e sensível para cuidar da experiência do cliente (CX), assegurando que cada interação na jornada e toda a comunicação sejam consistentes, claras e realmente valiosas. Aqui na Beep Saúde, nos orgulhamos de ter um NPS acima de 90, que reflete nossa reputação e cuidado com a experiência dos nossos clientes.

Responsibilities

  • Mapeamento e Otimização de Jornadas: Mapear, analisar, documentar e otimizar continuamente as jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos de dor (pain points), oportunidades de melhoria e gargalos de atrito para elevar a satisfação e retenção, contribuindo diretamente para o nosso alto NPS.
  • Gestão de Mensageria e Conteúdo (CX Writing): Cuidar de toda a mensageria (textos, comunicações, notificações e micro-textos), garantindo que estejam alinhados, acessíveis e alinhados à jornada do cliente.
  • Integração com a Tecnologia: Atuar lado a lado com o time de Produto e Tecnologia para desenvolver e implantar soluções que impactem positivamente a jornada e experiência dos nossos clientes.
  • Governança e Documentação: Organizar, documentar e ser o ponto focal para garantir o alinhamento e a disseminação de conhecimento sobre as jornadas e guidelines de comunicação entre as áreas envolvidas (ex: Marketing, Produto, Atendimento).
  • Análise de Dados de CX: Utilizar dados e feedbacks de clientes para embasar decisões e medir o impacto das melhorias implementadas nas jornadas e na comunicação, com foco na manutenção e aumento do NPS.
  • Garantir que as mensagens estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes da Meta, com pleno entendimento das políticas da plataforma e aplicação correta dos tipos aprovados (utilidade, autenticação, marketing e serviço) nos fluxos de comunicação.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Formação/Experiência: Sólida formação ou experiência comprovada em Design (UX/UI), Comunicação, Marketing, Produto ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Pessoa extremamente detalhista, organizada e com alta sensibilidade para trabalhar com a experiência e a comunicação humana (empatia e escuta ativa).
  • Visão Customer Centric: Capacidade de colocar o cliente no centro de todas as decisões e enxergar de forma holística todos os pontos de contato (touchpoints) da jornada.
  • Habilidade de Colaboração: Facilidade e experiência em trabalhar com diferentes equipes multifuncionais, especialmente times de Tecnologia, Produto, Operações.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita para defender o ponto de vista do cliente e traduzir complexidades em mensagens simples e eficazes.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) e ferramentas de mapeamento de jornada (Miro, Figma, etc.).
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de princípios de CX Writing e Microcopy.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de CX, especialmente gestão de NPS e CSAT.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Executive Director of Physical Facilities Management (PFM) provides strategic leadership and operational oversight of Howard University’s facilities operations and physical assets. Reporting to the Vice President for Capital Planning & Facilities Management, the Executive Director is responsible for directing daily facilities operations, overseeing multimillion-dollar budgets, managing external service contracts, and guiding University-wide space planning. This position ensures that the University’s buildings, infrastructure, and grounds are safe, reliable, efficient, and aligned with Howard’s mission and long-term strategic priorities.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises directors, managers, professional staff, skilled trades, custodial teams, contractors, and other personnel engaged in facilities management and space planning.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include senior leadership, academic deans, and administrative units to ensure facilities operations and space utilization align with institutional priorities. External contacts include architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, utilities, and regulatory agencies to oversee compliance, project execution, and contractual agreements. The role also requires close collaboration with Howard University Hospital and inter‑agency partners, as joint projects and shared facilities work will be prevalent.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides leadership for daily operations of maintenance, custodial services, grounds, utilities, and building systems, ensuring service quality, responsiveness, and safety.
  • Oversees financial management of PFM operations, including budget development, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost control for operating and capital funds.
  • Administers major vendor and service contracts for custodial, maintenance, utilities, and energy procurement, ensuring performance accountability and fiscal soundness.
  • Directs allocation, planning, and utilization of University building space to support academic, residential, and administrative priorities.
  • Guides preventive and deferred maintenance programs, sustainability initiatives, and capital renewal efforts to extend the life of University assets.
  • Ensures compliance with OSHA, EPA, fire/life safety, and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Establishes key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational efficiency, contractor performance, timeliness and quality of work, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provides strong customer service, fostering collaboration and timely communication across the University with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serves as the University’s representative in negotiations with external vendors, contractors, and government agencies on facilities‑related matters.
  • Collaborates with Capital Planning & Facilities Management leadership to align space management, renovations, and new construction with institutional priorities.
  • Leads emergency preparedness and disaster recovery planning for facilities operations and infrastructure systems.
  • Contributes to long‑term campus facilities and capital master planning, aligning operational initiatives with the University’s strategic growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Facilitates professional development opportunities for internal and external partners, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence across the facilities ecosystem.
  • Performs other duties as assigned in support of the University’s mission and campus environment.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in higher education facilities management, contract negotiation, and budget administration.
  • Strong knowledge of building operations, energy management, and space utilization strategies.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams, service providers, and complex budgets.
  • Ability to develop long‑term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem‑solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
  • Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University’s mission.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, architecture, or related field and eight (8) to ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in facilities management, contract administration, and budget oversight; or a Master’s degree with five (5) years of directly related experience. Certified Educational Facilities Professional (CEFP) credential from the Association of Physical Plant Administrators (APPA) is strongly preferred, reflecting advanced expertise and commitment to professional excellence in educational facilities management.

Expected Salary Range: $170,000 - $190,000

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Psicologia, Pedagogia, Administração, Recursos Humanos e afins.
  • Experiência prévia com Desenvolvimento Humano Organizacional, principalmente com programas de carreira e performance.

  • Experiência com ciclos de Gestão de Performance.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de aprendizagem e metodologias de gestão de projetos.

Local de trabalho

  • Glória, Rio de Janeiro/RJ
  • Modalidade: presencial

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

  • Strong Excel skills and familiarity with workflow tools (e.g., Monday.com or similar systems)
  • Highly organized with strong follow‑through on tasks and escalations

  • Strong communication skills for ongoing follow‑ups and coordination across teams

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • Experience in legal billing, legal operations, or law firm billing in a financial services.
  • Candidates coming from law firms, in‑house legal departments, vendor management teams, or finance‑adjacent operational roles with substantial exposure to outside counsel billing and invoice workflow management will be viewed favorably.
  • Experience handling high‑volume invoice tracking, rejected invoice resolution, payment‑cycle coordination, discount‑period monitoring, and support for aged invoice reconciliation is strongly preferred.

Specific Technical Skills Needed

  • Strong proficiency in Excel and Monday.com; experience with invoice tracking, billing reports, document management, and workflow systems; ability to maintain accurate records, monitor discount and payment deadlines, and support billing coordination across Legal, Finance, and AP.

Specific Soft Skills Needed

  • Professionalism and cross‑functional collaboration
  • Time management, and problem‑solving

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate-collateralized commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses across the United States that do not have access to traditional financing. Overview

In this role, you'll help create a reliable Azure platform that supports quick, secure, and consistent deployment of containerized applications.

As an Azure Platform Engineer, you'll turn application and business needs into scalable cloud solutions, automate processes, enhance monitoring, and ensure security and governance are upheld throughout the Azure environment.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain Azure resource architectures that run containerized applications, primarily focusing on Azure Container Apps environments.
  • Configure and manage essential Azure services such as Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, virtual networks, load balancers, and private endpoints to support application workloads.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code tools like Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform to provision Azure environments consistently, reliably, and with full auditing.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize Dockerfiles and container images for Linux-based applications, ensuring they are lean, secure, and perform smoothly at runtime.
  • Implement secure secrets management for containers by leveraging Azure Key Vault and native Azure integrations for handling connection strings, API keys, certificates, and passwords.
  • Integrate vulnerability scanning into the image build and deployment workflows, collaborating with development and security teams to promptly address any issues.
  • Configure and maintain monitoring setups using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and set up alerts for key health and performance metrics to keep applications and platforms observable, reliable, and cost-effective.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents affecting containerized workloads, including networking, identity, configurations, or performance across the Azure platform.
  • Analyze resource usage and Azure cost data to spot optimization opportunities, such as right-sizing resources, adjusting scaling policies, optimizing images, or selecting the best services for the job.
  • Collaborate closely with application development, data, and security teams to define platform requirements and establish best practices for deploying and managing services on Azure.

Requirements

  • Education: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or an equivalent blend of practical experience.
  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands‑on expertise with cloud platforms, including at least 2+ years honing your skills specifically with Microsoft Azure.

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure, confidently navigating core services such as compute, networking, storage, identity, and monitoring to deliver robust solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience deploying and managing containerized applications using Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service, or other leading container platforms, ensuring smooth and scalable operations.
  • Skilled in Docker, adept at crafting and maintaining Dockerfiles, managing container images, and troubleshooting runtime issues on Linux environments.
  • Strong Linux systems administration capabilities, including process and package management, filesystem permissions, basic networking, systemd, and comprehensive logging.
  • Proven experience with Azure Container Registry, efficiently handling image lifecycle management tasks such as versioning, promotion across environments, and retention policies.
  • Practical knowledge of Azure Key Vault and implementing secrets management best practices for secure application workloads.
  • Familiar with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and methodologies, including Bicep, ARM, Terraform, or their equivalents, complemented by Git‑based workflows.
  • Experienced with CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps Pipelines to automate building, testing, and deploying containerized applications seamlessly.
  • Solid understanding of Azure networking fundamentals, covering VNets, subnets, NSGs, private endpoints, DNS, and hybrid connectivity, alongside core cloud security principles such as IAM/RBAC, managed identities, network security, encryption, and logging.

  • Docker Compose
  • git

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Location :Rio de Janeiro

ERP Eligibility: ((cust_erp))

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up‑to‑date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

Key Competencies:

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degreeis mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core.

You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD’s, LLD’s, WO’s, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition

  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Affimed Networks EPC products

What we offer?

  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.

description:
Contexte et environnement

A posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. O cargo exige interação e colaboração frequentes com uma ampla gama de partes internas e externas, incluindo clientes internos, escritórios de advocacia, associações do setor, parceiros de joint ventures, fornecedores e autoridades governamentais. Dada a natureza dessas interações, a função demanda fortes habilidades de negociação e a capacidade de se engajar de forma estratégica e eficaz com diferentes públicos.

Activités

O(a) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Principais Atividades

  • Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  • Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  • Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  • Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  • Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  • Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  • Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  • One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Responsabilités

O Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais. O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Nível de qualificação: Bacharelado em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB). Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Experiência em estruturas contratuais sofisticadas de E&P é um diferencial, incluindo estruturas complexas de governança em múltiplos regimes jurídicos (PSC, Concessão), unitizações, redeterminações, bem como contratos de serviços técnicos (EPCIs e outros).

Who Are We?

Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.

Our Vision

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

Are You Ready?

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Marketing Engineer - a new kind of role built for the AI era. This isn't a traditional content manager or social media coordinator. You are a one-person growth machine who uses AI tools as your force multiplier. You will own organic growth across all DM brands: social media, SEO, blog, and founder personal brands - executing at a volume and quality that would previously require a full team.

This role was created because the future of marketing belongs to individuals who know how to direct AI — not just use it. If you've been quietly building a content or automation operation powered by AI tools, this was designed for you.

  • Run and grow DM, FutureFinance.com, and founder personal brand accounts across X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok

Brand & Strategy

  • Maintain consistent brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across every platform
  • Report weekly on reach, engagement, follower growth, web traffic, and lead attribution

Must-Haves

  • Excellent written English - you can write in multiple brand voices and understand the difference between education, entertainment, and conversion content
  • Genuine interest in crypto, DeFi, or Web3 - you don't need to be a technical expert, but you need to care about the space

Strong Advantages

  • Experience running or growing accounts in the finance, crypto, or education niche
  • Background in building AI-powered content workflows or automations (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom scripts)
  • Familiarity with tools like Buffer, Notion, Ahrefs/SEMrush, Canva, or CapCut
  • Experience supporting personal brand building for executives or founders
  • Video editing or short-form video production skills

Benefits

  • 100% remote and async-friendly culture

description:
• Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.
  • Desejável vivência anterior com as rotinas de unidade intensiva ou semi intensiva.Atividades:
  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas específicas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente. Conferir e repor o carro e maleta de PCR, após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações. Fazer conferência mensal dos materiais permanentes e consignados (VALIDADE). Contactar equipe médica e anestesistas sobre procedimentos eletivos e emergências. Preparar sala e mesas para exames e/ou cirurgias;
  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os médicos nos procedimentos realizados, tais como: Cateterismo Cardíaco, Angioplastia (coronariana e vascular), Arteriografias (cerebral, renal, pulmonar, medular, mesentérica, MMII e MMSS, Drenagem Biliar, Colocação de Filtro de Veia Cava e PICC, Embolização Cerebral, Quimoembolização (hepáticas, uterinas e mesentéricas), Estudo Eletrofisiológico + Ablação, Aortografia. Utilizar EPIs específicos: capote de chumbo, protetor de tireoide, óculos plumbífero, dosímetro, (sala de Hemodinâmica chumbada com aparelho de intensificador de Raio X). -Verificar os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.;
  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade em sala, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu exame. Confirmar e checar JEJUM, ALERGIA, especificamente à IÔDO com o paciente.
  • Receber e preparar o paciente na sala de Hemodinâmica. Identificação do paciente no livro de sala com número de exame, médico que realizará o procedimento, horários de início e término. Cuidados de enfermagem: posicionamento do paciente na mesa de exame, monitorização (Sapo², F.C, F.R, PNI, PAM, Temperatura., Co²), punção venosa periférica, sondagem vesical, aspiração orotraqueal, oxigenioterapia, administração de medicamentos, assepsia e antissepsia.Cobrança de folha dos materiais utilizados em sala durante os exames. Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob seus cuidados em sala, registrando na evolução qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.Outras informações:
  • Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro - RJ

title: Coordenador(a) Fiscal - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga

O coordenador(a), irá atuar na revisão do compliance fiscal de tributos diretos e indiretos, com o intuito de assegurar o cumprimento tempestivo do pagamento dos tributos devidos pelas empresas do Grupo, bem como acompanhar e garantir a entrega com qualidade das diversas obrigações acessórias previstas no ordenamento brasileiro. Atuará de forma estratégica na coordenação das atividades fiscais da companhia, com forte perfil consultivo, garantindo conformidade tributária, acompanhamento contínuo das mudanças na legislação e suporte técnico às áreas internas, especialmente frente aos desafios e oportunidades da Reforma Tributária. Contribuirá para a eficiência fiscal e mitigação de riscos, com foco especial em operações e projetos de energias renováveis.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como referência técnica em matéria fiscal, apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica da companhia.
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar pareceres, estudos e memorandos fiscais, com caráter preventivo, consultivo e estratégico.
  • Ser o ponto focal para dúvidas fiscais internas e de fornecedores (ex.: emissão de notas, retenções, enquadramento de operações, estabelecimento, etc.).
  • Coordenar as rotinas fiscais, assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações principais e acessórias dentro dos prazos legais e com qualidade.
  • Revisar periodicamente a conformidade das obrigações acessórias, incluindo SPED Fiscal, EFD‑Contribuições, ECD, DCTF e PER/DCOMP.
  • Garantir a escrituração fiscal tempestiva, identificando e corrigindo desvios quando houver intempestividade.
  • Garantir o recolhimento de todos os tributos no prazo.
  • Atuar na revisão do compliance de tributos diretos e indiretos, com ênfase em IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Acompanhar, interpretar e disseminar atualizações da legislação tributária municipal, estadual e federal.
  • Atualizar e monitorar de forma contínua a Matriz de Riscos Tributários.
  • Mapear oportunidades fiscais e identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos tributários para otimização dos processos.
  • Monitorar os impactos da Reforma Tributária, avaliando riscos, oportunidades e efeitos nos modelos de negócio atuais e futuros.
  • Apoiar no controle, solicitação, manutenção e renovação de regimes especiais.
  • Gerir e acompanhar incentivos fiscais aplicáveis às operações.
  • Acompanhar e atender fiscalizações, auditorias e demandas de órgãos fiscalizadores, fornecendo informações, apoio técnico e interface com consultorias externas e autoridades fiscais.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com Controladoria, Contabilidade, Jurídico, Financeiro e Projetos, promovendo alinhamento e antecipação de riscos.
  • Suportar a estruturação fiscal de novos contratos, operações e projetos — especialmente no setor de energias renováveis (geração, comercialização de energia, incentivos regionais, etc.).
  • Gerenciar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe fiscal, promovendo atualização técnica contínua e boas práticas.
  • Criar, revisar e atualizar procedimentos da área.
  • Reportar indicadores tributários de compliance.
  • Garantir o recolhimento dos tributos e a entrega das obrigações acessórias com qualidade e dentro dos prazos legais.
  • Manter-se atualizado diante de todas as alterações legislativas pertinentes ao setor e à área tributária.
  • Mapear novas oportunidades, otimizações dos processos fiscais e eventuais riscos fiscais.
  • Apoiar nas previsões orçamentárias da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formado em Ciências Contábeis e/ou Direito;
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório) – Será testado;
  • Experiência de pelo menos 7 anos na área tributária/fiscal;
  • Experiência sólida na área fiscal, com atuação consultiva;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de impostos diretos e indiretos;
  • Experiência prévia no setor de energias renováveis será considerado um diferencial relevante;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas ERP e ferramentas fiscais;
  • Conhecimentos avançados de Excel;
  • Visão analítica/crítica, proatividade, organização e dinamismo.

Informações adicionais

  • Local de Atuação : Rio de Janeiro - Bairro Jardim Botânico - Brasil
  • Formato Híbrido (2 dias de home office)
